title: An n-vector commutes with the pointwise interval integral of a continuous covector family
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and a, b ∈ ℝ. Let f : ℝ → Λ^m(ℝ^P) be continuous, where Λ^m(ℝ^P) = Covector (Eucl P) m is the space of continuous alternating m-linear maps (ℝ^P)^m → ℝ with the operator norm. Let c ∈ Λ^m(ℝ^P) satisfy c(v) = ∫_a^b f(s)(v) ds for every v : Fin m → ℝ^P, and let w ∈ Λ_m(ℝ^P) = NVector (Eucl P) m be a continuous linear functional on m-covectors. Then ∫_a^b w(f(s)) ds = w(c). Integrals are interval integrals for Lebesgue measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → Covector (Eucl P) m) (c : Covector (Eucl P) m) (w : NVector (Eucl P) m), Continuous f → (∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, c v = ∫ s in a..b, f s v) → ∫ s in a..b, w (f s) = w c
